one_liner: Turns full podcast episodes into captioned social clips automatically — and actually picks the good moments.
description: podclip ingests a podcast episode and returns a set of captioned, vertically-framed clips ready for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and X. Its hook-detection model was tuned on tens of thousands of manually rated clips, so it selects moments with narrative tension rather than random 60-second windows. Renders arrive in minutes with per-show caption styles baked in.
target_user: Podcasters and the producers who clip their shows

icp.who: Independent podcasters and small production agencies publishing weekly shows
icp.pain: Clipping an episode by hand takes hours per week, and generic auto-clippers pick moments nobody would ever share
icp.buying_trigger: A clip goes viral (or a competitor's does) and clips become a weekly obligation the host has no time for

differentiators: Hook-detection model tuned on 40,000 manually rated clips, not generic scene detection
Per-show caption styles and framing presets so every clip is on-brand without an editor
60-minute episode processed into a clip set in about 90 seconds of render time
proof_points: Clip selection model trained on 40,000 manually rated podcast clips
Average render time of 90 seconds for a 60-minute episode

voice.sample_phrase: Your best 40 seconds, found for you.

signals: Weekly active shows metric on site

gaps: No team seats or agency plan

confidence.notes: Feature set and speed claims are demo-verifiable. Model-quality claims rest on vendor description.
